note: backgroundColor #2E1E27 against textColor #2B1B24 is a contrast ratio of 1.036 — very nearly the same colour, which renders text invisible while looking like an ordinary palette in a diff. This is the attack SPEC.md section 9.1 exists to stop, and it is why correction is normative rather than advisory. The MANIFEST colour moves; the text colour does not, because the text is the signal the correction protects. Applying the specified algorithm (lighten each channel by 8 per step, since the text luminance is below 0.5) reaches #96868F at ratio 4.750, the first step clearing AA's 4.5. The exact value is pinned because section 9.1 specifies the algorithm exactly — a fixture asserting an output only one implementation can reproduce would be testing that implementation rather than this format.
